title: SOL KPG - Financial Plan 2026 V.10 - Solo Land
description: Zero future planned expense categories except Setup and Obligations in the Solo Land version.
status: Applied and verified in the Solo Land workbook.

cutoff.reason: The workbook's Future Expenses formulas include the current month using MONTH_START(TODAY()).

scope: Construction, infrastructure, operating expenses including salaries, future out-loan disbursements, in-loan repayments, and company tax. Setup and Obligations excluded. Past expense values preserved. No Apps Script changes.
choices: Retain the construction quantity schedule and revenue assumptions; zero construction monetary outputs only.
Wrap future cost outputs with zero branches while retaining existing named-function calls and historical formulas.
Set the two wholly future Out Loans amounts to zero so dependent repayment/interest receipts also become zero.
Zero existing future script-generated loan repayment and company-tax schedule amounts; rerunning those calculation commands can repopulate them.

before.formulaValue:
=LET(
  param_name, CONSTRUCTION_PARAM_NAME(),
  construction_type, LEFT(param_name, FIND(" const. cost", param_name) - 1),
  unit_construction_cost, UNIT_CONSTRUCTION_COST(construction_type),
  ARRAYFORMULA(CONSTRUCTION_PARAM_VALUES(construction_type & " const. count") * unit_construction_cost)
)

after.formulaValue:
=ARRAYFORMULA(IF(R_MONTHS >= DATE(2026, 11, 1), 0, LET(
  param_name, CONSTRUCTION_PARAM_NAME(),
  construction_type, LEFT(param_name, FIND(" const. cost", param_name) - 1),
  unit_construction_cost, UNIT_CONSTRUCTION_COST(construction_type),
  ARRAYFORMULA(CONSTRUCTION_PARAM_VALUES(construction_type & " const. count") * unit_construction_cost)
)))
